entries.title: Exodus 12:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 12:2
segments: "This month [shall be] your beginning of months; it [shall be] the first month of the year to you.

entries.title: Exodus 12:3
segments: "Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying: 'On the tenth [day] of this month every man shall take for himself a lamb, according to the house of [his] father, a lamb for a household.

entries.title: Exodus 12:4
segments: 'And if the household is too small for the lamb, let him and his neighbor next to his house take [it] according to the number of the persons; according to each man's need you shall make your count for the lamb.

entries.title: Exodus 12:5
segments: 'Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year. You may take [it] from the sheep or from the goats.

entries.title: Exodus 12:6
segments: 'Now you shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month. Then the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at twilight.

entries.title: Exodus 12:7
segments: 'And they shall take [some] of the blood and put [it] on the two doorposts and on the lintel of the houses where they eat it.

entries.title: Exodus 12:8
segments: 'Then they shall eat the flesh on that night; roasted in fire, with unleavened bread [and] with bitter [herbs] they shall eat it.

entries.title: Exodus 12:9
segments: 'Do not eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted in fire-its head with its legs and its entrails.

entries.title: Exodus 12:10
segments: 'You shall let none of it remain until morning, and what remains of it until morning you shall burn with fire.

entries.title: Exodus 12:11
segments: 'And thus you shall eat it: [with] a belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand. So you shall eat it in haste. It [is] the LORD'S Passover.

entries.title: Exodus 12:12
segments: 'For I will pass through the land of Egypt on that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 12:13
segments: 'Now the blood shall be a sign for you on the houses where you [are]. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you; and the plague shall not be on you to destroy [you] when I strike the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 12:14
segments: 'So this day shall be to you a memorial; and you shall keep it as a feast to the LORD throughout your generations. You shall keep it as a feast by an everlasting ordinance.

entries.title: Exodus 12:15
segments: 'Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the first day you shall remove leaven from your houses. For whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that person shall be cut off from Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 12:16
segments: 'On the first day [there shall be] a holy convocation, and on the seventh day there shall be a holy convocation for you. No manner of work shall be done on them; but [that]  which everyone must eat-that only may be prepared by you.

entries.title: Exodus 12:17
segments: 'So you shall observe [the Feast of] Unleavened Bread, for on this same day I will have brought your armies out of the land of Egypt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations as an everlasting ordinance.

entries.title: Exodus 12:18
segments: 'In the first [month], on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty-first day of the month at evening.

entries.title: Exodus 12:19
segments: 'For seven days no leaven shall be found in your houses, since whoever eats what is leavened, that same person shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether [he is] a stranger or a native of the land.

entries.title: Exodus 12:20
segments: 'You shall eat nothing leavened; in all your dwellings you shall eat unleavened bread.'"

entries.title: Exodus 12:21
segments: ¶Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Pick out and take lambs for yourselves according to your families, and kill the Passover [lamb].

entries.title: Exodus 12:22
segments: "And you shall take a bunch of hyssop, dip [it] in the blood that [is] in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two doorposts with the blood that [is] in the basin. And none of you shall go out of the door of his house until morning.

entries.title: Exodus 12:23
segments: "For the LORD will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when He sees the blood on the lintel and on the two doorposts, the LORD will pass over the door and not allow the destroyer to come into your houses to strike [you].

entries.title: Exodus 12:24
segments: "And you shall observe this thing as an ordinance for you and your sons forever.

entries.title: Exodus 12:25
segments: "It will come to pass when you come to the land which the LORD will give you, just as He promised, that you shall keep this service.

entries.title: Exodus 12:26
segments: "And it shall be, when your children say to you, 'What do you mean by this service?'

entries.title: Exodus 12:27
segments: "that you shall say, 'It [is] the Passover sacrifice of the LORD, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt when He struck the Egyptians and delivered our households.'" So the people bowed their heads and worshiped.

entries.title: Exodus 12:28
segments: Then the children of Israel went away and did [so]; just as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

entries.title: Exodus 12:29
segments: ¶And it came to pass at midnight that the LORD struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who [was] in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

entries.title: Exodus 12:30
segments: So Pharaoh rose in the night, he, all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for [there was] not a house where [there was] not one dead.

entries.title: Exodus 12:31
segments: Then he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, "Rise, go out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel. And go, serve the LORD as you have said.

entries.title: Exodus 12:32
segments: "Also take your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also."

entries.title: Exodus 12:33
segments: And the Egyptians urged the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste. For they said, "We [shall] all [be] dead."

entries.title: Exodus 12:34
segments: So the people took their dough before it was leavened, having their kneading bowls bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.

entries.title: Exodus 12:35
segments: Now the children of Israel had done according to the word of Moses, and they had asked from the Egyptians articles of silver, articles of gold, and clothing.

entries.title: Exodus 12:36
segments: And the LORD had given the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they granted them [what they requested]. Thus they plundered the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 12:37
segments: ¶Then the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides children.

entries.title: Exodus 12:38
segments: A mixed multitude went up with them also, and flocks and herds-a great deal of livestock.

entries.title: Exodus 12:39
segments: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they had brought out of Egypt; for it was not leavened, because they were driven out of Egypt and could not wait, nor had they prepared provisions for themselves.

entries.title: Exodus 12:40
segments: Now the sojourn of the children of Israel who lived in Egypt [was] four hundred and thirty years.

entries.title: Exodus 12:41
segments: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years-on that very same day-it came to pass that all the armies of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 12:42
segments: It [is] a night of solemn observance to the LORD for bringing them out of the land of Egypt. This [is] that night of the LORD, a solemn observance for all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

entries.title: Exodus 12:43
segments: ¶And the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, "This [is] the ordinance of the Passover: No foreigner shall eat it.

entries.title: Exodus 12:44
segments: "But every man's servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then he may eat it.

entries.title: Exodus 12:45
segments: "A sojourner and a hired servant shall not eat it.

entries.title: Exodus 12:46
segments: "In one house it shall be eaten; you shall not carry any of the flesh outside the house, nor shall you break one of its bones.

entries.title: Exodus 12:47
segments: "All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

entries.title: Exodus 12:48
segments: "And when a stranger dwells with you [and wants] to keep the Passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as a native of the land. For no uncircumcised person shall eat it.

entries.title: Exodus 12:49
segments: "One law shall be for the native-born and for the stranger who dwells among you."

entries.title: Exodus 12:50
segments: Thus all the children of Israel did; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.

entries.title: Exodus 12:51
segments: And it came to pass, on that very same day, that the LORD brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt according to their armies.
